title: Akiyama Mizuki — You Gotta Come With Me!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, nice! The lake of mystery's right where I left it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, I still can't get over how strange this place is!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I came here for no real reason, but I felt like it now that things have settled down with Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, I still have a ton of questions about this part of SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't stop thinking about it.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Your sketch of Mafuyu...!
I've seen pics of it before, but never the original.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, it was really inside the lake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it isn't even wet...
How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We talked about how a bunch of stuff might be hidden in this lake.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But if I had a SEKAI like this, I wonder what would it be like?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, no... Let's not go there... Mhm...
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you two! I let myself in!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I came to hang out!
Were you two taking a walk?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes... We've been coming here on occasion.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's Mafuyu doing, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu? We went to a diner the other day together. She's more or less back to normal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She wasn't in pain?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She wasn't in as much pain as before...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Being with all of you does seem to make her feel better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. If that's true, then I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How about you, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? What about me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You had a serious look on your face just now... Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? No, you've got it all wrong!
I was just thinking about something and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What were you thinking about...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I was thinking about what my SEKAI would be like if I had one. This lake would probably be filled with cute clothes and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They usually shrink and wrinkle after you try to dry them out, but everything from this lake has been bone dry for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, how fun would that be? Just the thought of it really excited me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, is that what was on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. What else would you expect of me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Also, that reminds me!
How many of Kanade's songs have you heard coming from this lake?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know, but many...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, she said she heard more when she was with Mafuyu. And then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So warm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len mentioned how Mafuyu said she felt warm inside when she heard one of these songs...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really...? So, if we wait long enough, then we should also get to hear that song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know, but would you like to wait for it together...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you wanna?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd rather not be all by myself, so let's sit and wait together♪ Criss-cross applesauce!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why do we have to sit like that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Dunno, just felt like it.
C'mon, you two! Sit with me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, fine...
